claims.excerpt: How GRACE Follow-On Uses Satellite Separation to Investigate Water Movement
claims.claim: GRACE Follow-On uses changes in satellite separation to investigate water movement.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: The changing inter-satellite distance is a raw measurement used to infer shifts in mass. The mission follows changes involving groundwater, lakes and rivers, soil moisture, glaciers, ice sheets and changes in sea level attributable to water added to the oceans.

claims.materiality: This is the piece’s central framing.
